title: Feature: Browse the launch catalog
references: PRD: PRD.md (FR1 Browse the launch catalog)
Architecture: ADD.md (layers, routes, folder structure, ADR 4)
API: GET http://localhost:3000/activities (already running; do not start it)
body:
Implement FR1: a public catalog page at `/launches` that reads launches from the ActivityBookings API and renders them server-side with JSP/JSTL.

## Scope

- Fetch launches from `GET /activities` on every request. No caching, no database.
- Show name, date, location, price, duration and maximum seats per launch.
- Include only launches whose status is `published` or `confirmed`; exclude `draft`, `done` and `cancelled`.
- Order the list by launch date ascending.
- Empty state when no visible launch exists.
- Error state with a retry action when the API call fails.
- Each launch links to `/launches/{id}` (the detail page is implemented by `feat-launch-detail`, not here).
- Anonymous visitors see log in and register links; the header is session-aware.

## Out of scope

- Search and sort controls (FR3), launch detail page (FR2), authentication forms and booking.
- Remaining-seat calculation: the API does not expose availability; show `maxParticipants` only.
- Client-side JavaScript or any local persistence.

## Observed API contract

`GET /activities` currently returns an array with fields: `id`, `name`, `slug`, `price` (number), `date` (string; may be date-only like `2026-12-20` or ISO datetime like `2026-08-25T14:00:00.000Z`), `duration` (minutes), `location`, `minParticipants`, `maxParticipants`, `status`, `userId`, `createdAt`.

- Statuses observed: `draft`, `published`; the contract also defines `confirmed`, `done`, `cancelled`.
- With the current data, visible launches are `activity-2` (2026-12-20) and `activity-3` (2026-08-25T14:00:00.000Z), so ascending order renders activity-3 first.
- Unknown JSON fields must be ignored so API additions do not break the client.
- Dates must be parsed tolerantly because of the two formats; sorting uses a normalized `LocalDate` derived from the first 10 characters (`yyyy-MM-dd`).

## Implementation notes

- The repository already has the Maven skeleton: `pom.xml`, Maven Wrapper (`mvnw.cmd`), `AppConfig`, packages, `web.xml` and test dependencies. Do not recreate them.
- Use `AppConfig.fromEnvironment()` once per servlet lifecycle; pass dependencies through constructors (no framework DI).
- All API access goes through `ApiClient`; no other class may construct `HttpClient`.
- Services must not import `jakarta.servlet`. JSPs use JSTL/EL only, no scriptlets, and escape dynamic output with `c:out`.
- Do not log JWTs, passwords or full API payloads. Network errors are wrapped in `ApiException` with a user-safe message.
- Map `ApiException` in `CatalogServlet` to the catalog error state (HTTP 200, friendly message, retry link to `/launches`). This satisfies the spec; the generic `error.jsp` is only needed for later features.
- Build with `mvnw.cmd` (Maven is not installed globally): `mvnw.cmd -B test` then `mvnw.cmd -B package`.

in: GET /launches reads GET /activities through ApiClient and renders a server-side catalog
Status filtering (published, confirmed) and ascending date ordering
Fields: name, date, location, price, duration, maximum seats
Empty state, error state with retry, anonymous login/register links
out: Search/sort controls, launch detail page, authentication, booking

acceptanceCriteria: WHEN a visitor requests /launches THE AstroBookings Client SHALL retrieve launches from the API.
THE AstroBookings Client SHALL display name, date, location, price, duration and maximum seats for each listed launch.
WHERE a launch status is draft, done or cancelled THE AstroBookings Client SHALL exclude it from the catalog.
THE AstroBookings Client SHALL order the catalog by launch date ascending.
IF the API returns zero visible launches THEN THE AstroBookings Client SHALL display an empty-state message.
IF the API request fails THEN the AstroBookings Client SHALL display an error message and offer a retry action.
WHEN a visitor selects a launch THE AstroBookings Client SHALL open the launch detail page for that launch.
WHILE no customer session exists THE AstroBookings Client SHALL display links to log in and register.

verification.check: CatalogServlet calls CatalogService, which calls LaunchesApi -> ApiClient GET /activities; E2E request to /launches returns 200 with API data.
launches.jsp renders name, formatted date, location, price, duration and maxParticipants; E2E assertions on rendered text.
CatalogServiceTest feeds draft/done/cancelled/published/confirmed and expects only the last two; E2E confirms 2 rows with current API data.
CatalogServiceTest mixes date-only and ISO datetime values and expects ascending LocalDate order; first row is activity-3 with current data.
CatalogServiceTest returns empty list; JSP shows empty-state text; E2E with stubbed empty response or filtered dataset.
CatalogServletTest throws ApiException and expects error attribute plus forward; JSP renders message and a retry link to /launches; E2E with API unavailable.
Each row contains an anchor to /launches/{id} built with c:url; E2E clicks a row and asserts the URL.
Header fragment checks empty sessionScope auth.token and renders /login and /register links; E2E asserts both are visible.

steps.title: Step 1 - Integration layer: read launches from the API
steps.description: Add the exception type, the activity DTO, the single HTTP client and the launches facade. Owner: coder.

tasks.title: Add exception/ApiException
tasks.description: Runtime exception with int status and user-safe message; static factories apiError(status, message) and networkError(cause). Never include tokens, passwords or full payloads in messages.

tasks.title: Add integration/dto/ActivityDto
tasks.description: Record with id, name, slug, price (BigDecimal), date (String), duration (int), location, minParticipants, maxParticipants, status. Annotate with @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown = true); keep date as String to tolerate date-only and ISO datetime values.

tasks.title: Add integration/ApiClient
tasks.description: Construct exactly one java.net.http.HttpClient from AppConfig (base URL, 5 s connect timeout, 10 s request timeout); expose JsonNode/String GET and typed List<T> GET helpers using Jackson ObjectMapper; map non-2xx to ApiException with status; map IOException/timeouts to networkError; log method, path and status only.

tasks.title: Add integration/LaunchesApi
tasks.description: Facade with List<ActivityDto> findAll() that calls ApiClient GET /activities and deserializes the array. Keep the class non-final and constructor-injected so Mockito can stub it in service tests.

steps.title: Step 2 - Service layer: visibility and ordering rules
steps.description: Filter, normalize and sort launches in a servlet-free service. Owner: coder.

tasks.title: Add service/LaunchSummary
tasks.description: Record used by the JSP: id, name, date (LocalDate), dateLabel (formatted e.g. 25 Aug 2026), location, price, durationMinutes, maxParticipants, status, bookable (published or confirmed).

tasks.title: Add tolerant date parsing
tasks.description: Package-private helper (e.g. LaunchDates) that parses yyyy-MM-dd from the first 10 characters and returns LocalDate; unparseable or null dates sort last while remaining visible. Format dateLabel with a fixed locale so rendering is deterministic.

tasks.title: Add service/CatalogService
tasks.description: Constructor takes LaunchesApi. getVisibleLaunches() fetches all activities, keeps only status published/confirmed (case-insensitive), sorts by LocalDate ascending (tie-break by name), and maps to LaunchSummary. Empty API list yields an empty list; ApiException propagates unchanged. No jakarta.servlet imports.

steps.title: Step 3 - Web layer: routes, wiring and error handling
steps.description: Expose /launches, redirect the home route, force UTF-8 and turn failures into the friendly catalog error state. Owner: coder.

tasks.title: Add web/CatalogServlet
tasks.description: @WebServlet("/launches"). In init() build AppConfig.fromEnvironment() -> ApiClient -> LaunchesApi -> CatalogService once. doGet calls getVisibleLaunches(), sets request attribute "launches", forwards to /WEB-INF/views/launches.jsp. Catch ApiException: log warning, set "errorMessage" with a friendly text, forward to the same JSP (HTTP 200) so the retry link is available. Never forward the raw exception message or stack trace.

tasks.title: Add web/HomeServlet
tasks.description: @WebServlet("") (exact context root, not "/" which would shadow the default servlet and static assets). doGet redirects to contextPath + "/launches".

tasks.title: Add web/filter/EncodingFilter
tasks.description: @WebFilter("/*") setting request/response character encoding to UTF-8 before the chain, so launch names with accents render correctly.

tasks.title: Confirm configuration wiring
tasks.description: Use the existing AppConfig (ASTRO_API_BASE_URL, default http://localhost:3000, 5 s/10 s timeouts) and web.xml session config (30 min, HttpOnly cookie). Add no new dependencies unless strictly required.

steps.title: Step 4 - Views: catalog page, states and styling
steps.description: JSP 4.0 + JSTL 3.0, no scriptlets. Owner: coder.

tasks.title: Add view fragments
tasks.description: WEB-INF/views/fragments/header.jspf and footer.jspf: HTML5 doctype, lang="en", meta viewport, CSS link built with c:url, site heading/nav, and a session-aware header. When sessionScope['auth.token'] is empty render links to /login and /register; otherwise show the session username (do not render the token).

tasks.title: Add launches.jsp
tasks.description: Taglibs core and fmt. Error state first: when errorMessage is present show an alert and a retry link to /launches, and do not attempt to list rows. Empty state when launches is empty. Otherwise a semantic table/list with one row per launch: name, dateLabel, location, price (fmt:formatNumber), durationMinutes (min), maxParticipants (max seats). Wrap each row's name in an anchor to c:url /launches/{id}. Escape all dynamic text with c:out.

tasks.title: Add assets/css/main.css
tasks.description: Small responsive stylesheet: readable typography, catalog table/cards, accessible focus states, error/empty banners. No CSS framework and no JavaScript.

tasks.title: Accessibility and output safety review
tasks.description: Semantic headings, table caption or section heading, sufficient contrast, keyboard-usable links, no scriptlets and no unescaped EL output; verify the page renders without a customer session.

steps.title: Step 5 - Build and manual smoke check
steps.description: Prove the WAR builds and the page works against the running API. Owner: coder.

tasks.title: Compile and package
tasks.description: Run `mvnw.cmd -B -DskipTests package`; fix compilation warnings/errors. The WAR must be target/astrobookings-client.war.

tasks.title: Manual verification with current data
tasks.description: Verified against the deployed instance: GET /launches returns 200 and lists only activity-3 and activity-2, activity-3 first, with all six columns (Launch, Date, Location, Price, Duration, Max seats) and detail links; GET / returns 302 to /astrobookings-client/launches; anonymous visitors see Log in and Register links and no JWT appears in the HTML. Playwright AC1-AC4, AC7 and AC8 pass.

tasks.title: Failure smoke check
tasks.description: Covered by the Playwright AC6 test against the fixture-backed deployment: a 503 from the API renders the friendly 'Launch catalog unavailable' alert with a 'Try again' link and no stack trace, and the retry recovers once the API answers again. Playwright AC5 (empty state) also passes.

steps.title: Step 6 - Automated tests and acceptance verification
steps.description: Owned by the tester agent (coder does not write tests). Tests use stubs and loopback only; no live external network.

tasks.title: CatalogServiceTest
tasks.description: Cover: status filtering (draft/done/cancelled excluded, published/confirmed kept), ascending order with mixed date formats, empty input, ApiException propagation, mapping to LaunchSummary. Stub LaunchesApi with Mockito.

tasks.title: ApiClientTest
tasks.description: Use a loopback com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer (or a mocked HttpClient) to assert 200 JSON list mapping, non-2xx -> ApiException with status, malformed JSON handling and timeout/IOException -> network error. No calls to localhost:3000.

tasks.title: CatalogServletTest
tasks.description: Mock HttpServletRequest/Response and CatalogService: success sets launches and forwards to /WEB-INF/views/launches.jsp; ApiException sets errorMessage and still forwards (HTTP 200); HomeServlet redirects to /launches.

tasks.title: AppConfigTest
tasks.description: Assert the default base URL, override via fromValues, blank fallback and trailing-slash normalization.

tasks.title: Playwright E2E
tasks.description: Verify /launches lists only visible launches in ascending order with the six fields, empty and error states, detail navigation to /launches/{id}, and log in/register links for anonymous visitors. Ensure no JWT appears in the HTML.

tasks.title: Update traceability
tasks.description: Tick the acceptance criteria in specs/feat-launch-catalog.spec.md, set the issue status to done and update PRD.md FR1 status to Done without changing scope.

tasks.title: Release notes and merge
tasks.description: CHANGELOG.md documents the 0.1.0 release, pom.xml was released as 0.1.0, and feat/launch-catalog was merged into main with a merge commit after `mvnw.cmd test` (30 tests) and `mvnw.cmd -DskipTests package` succeeded.
